diagnostic_question: Does full train-only covariance plus the all-train-only-request key Gram remain rank-deficient at any GRAM lexical position, proving that every faithful valid-z subset is singular?
upper_bound_semantics: K_all contains every train-only request key before valid-z filtering. For PSD covariance and Gram terms, a rank-deficient lambda*C_full + K_all^T*K_all proves every faithful valid-z key subset rank-deficient; a full-rank superset does not prove the faithful valid-z system invertible.

classification.logical_basis: For positive-semidefinite C and key Gram matrices, the faithful valid-z system uses a key subset of the measured all-request Gram. If lambda*C_full + K_all^T*K_all is rank-deficient, no valid-z subset can remove its remaining nullspace. Full rank of the superset is not sufficient to prove the valid-z system invertible.

declared_scope: S16-1 train-only inputs plus immutable S16-3 A4 terminal/request artifacts; no validation, internal-dev occurrence, or test files
